reviews.author: Tanmay SrivastavaTanmay Srivastava
reviews.text:
I placed the order on March 28th and received the laptop the very next day—excellent delivery speed!Now, about the laptop specs: it's a M4 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM, 512GB SSD, and a 13-inch Midnight display. The performance is top-notch; it doesn’t feel like an Air at all. Apple has really nailed it with the M-series silicon chips.The 13-inch screen is perfect for me—light and portable. You won’t feel like the screen is too small. I also own a Lenovo Legion with a 15.6-inch display, and I find the MacBook's display to be very impressive. Despite what some online comments say, I don’t notice any issues with the 60Hz refresh rate.My main use case is coding—both web and app development. The MacBook performs flawlessly. Build times are very short, and Android Studio runs smoothly.One thing to note: since it doesn’t have a fan, it can get warm when multiple apps are open. But overall, I highly recommend it without hesitation. I’ll provide an update after using it for a month.
  
Read more

reviews.author: NabinoyNabinoy
reviews.text:
I recently purchased the MacBook M4 with 512GB storage. The performance is next level – from multitasking to app development, everything is super smooth. The new M4 chip is lightning fast, and the battery life is truly impressive.The 512GB SSD of storage is ideal for day-to-day work, providing ample storage space for projects. And now the design – Starlight color is simply amazing. The slim design makes it the ultimate portable laptop.The screen is bright and clear, the keyboard is extremely comfortable, and the overall build quality is premium and solid.If you're in search of a fast, portable, and future-proof laptop, this is 100% worth the money.

    Dream laptopRecently upgraded from a ASUS  vivobook 14 2020 model ( intel i5 10th generation) to this gorgeous beauty. I was initially eyeing the m4 Pro variant then this launched and I got it in half the price of that of m4 Pro during Amazon summer sales. Battery is superb. One thing midnight is very prone to fingerprint and even a tiny speckle of dust is visible so is you don’t want to clean it daily I suggest go for other colours but for me I am happy with my purchase and choice of colour. My ASUS mouse pairs with it perfectly. Arrived in very secure package. Plus I think this model is cheaper than m2 or m3 if you go for 16gb variant so that’s a win for sure. You get adapter and cable which is of very good quality. One thing I wished the adapter should have been the same colour as MacBook.Cons: you have to get ms office key for professional that’s a must as I am not used to inbuilt Mac software’s that’s an additional cost.You have to get external ports. In my previous laptop had no such worries.If you have used an I phone you will not face any problem using MacBook.I got darzo brand MacBook cover. That was the cheapest option on AmazonPlus pi box hub. My mouse connects through it perfectly as per Hdmi port I haven’t used that but I guess this Is also one of the cheapest hub you can get.

reviews.author: VivekVivek
reviews.text:
Its my first time switching from windows to mac and its a great experience. Its light and blazingly fast.ProsDisplay is good, text is readable. Can zoom in on any webpage with gesturesTrackpad is great, Gestures are smooth.13" Size is perfect for portable use, you can always connect a monitor to it at home/office.Battery level is unbelievable, on light usage it easily lasts hours. Im yet to test it on heavy usage.Premium build quality, the moment I used it, its unlike any other windows laptop I've used.Software is mostly bug free, the popular phrase "it just works" is true, barring few apple intelligence related apps.Easy to learn MacOSGood for programming.ConsAlthough display is good, I wish apple had added 120fps + OLED.Need to buy a dongle to connect my monitor.Apple intelligence / siri is ok, not at the level where I can say its truly helpful/game changing.Regarding heat levels, it does get hot if you keep it on your lap for long time. I use it on the table so I don't notice the heat at all, but on my lap I can definitely feel the bottom of the device get hot.

reviews.author: MedhatithiMedhatithi
reviews.text:
Just got it 2 days ago. So far, just overwhelmed. I dont play games on laptop so cannot comment but have been running Garageband without any problem at all.Video, streaming, mail, spotify and rest everything else just running fine.I have a MacBook Pro 2020 also and that one sometimes hangs with Garageband running but no issues observed in this one so far.Its lightweight, portable and feels almost like carrying an iPad with better performance.I am also loving the phone mirror feature and its working absolutely fine with my iphone 14
